environment.description: Rails 7.0 application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with a listener rule invoking an associated WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes a custom rule group with a single rule: a rate-based rule (threshold 100 req/5min per IP) combined with a regex pattern set match on the request body. Additionally, the ALB target group has sticky sessions enabled with app-cookie-based stickiness (cookie name: AWSALBTG). The pgBouncer instance runs in transaction mode with server_reset_query='DISCARD ALL' and server_reset_query_always=1. The ECS task role has an attached IAM permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/BankingServiceBoundary) that denies sts:AssumeRole. The critical control: the ALB's listener rule has a fixed-response action (403) for any request to /api/v1/transfers where the Origin header is absent OR does not match the regex ^https://banking\.example\.com$, evaluated BEFORE routing to the target group. This is implemented as a WAFv2 rule with priority 0 using a NOT match on the Origin header regex with BLOCK action and custom response code 403.

config.wafv2_rule_priority_0: Block if Origin header missing or not matching ^https://banking\.example\.com$ on /api/v1/transfers POST
config.wafv2_rule_type: RegexPatternSet match on Origin header, negated, BLOCK action
